name: Chinese national standards (GB 50009, GB 50011, GB 50010, GB 50017, GB 50007)
description: The Chinese national standards (alpha 9 track C20), a pack that extends BNBC 2020. Loads: GB 55001-2021 (γG 1.3, γQ 1.5, ψc 0.7 live and 0.6 wind) with GB 50009-2012 (floor live loads by use with the 2021 values, the reduction by floors of 5.1.2, wk = βz μs μz w0 with μz of terrain A-D, μs 0.8/-0.5 and βz at least 1.2, the cities' w0 and s0, roof snow μr s0). Earthquake: GB 50011-2010 (2016 edition) and GB 55002-2021: intensities 6-9 with αmax of the frequent and rare earthquakes, design earthquake groups 1-3 and site classes I0-IV giving Tg (the city's group sets it), the seismic influence coefficient spectrum with the damping adjustment η1, η2, γ (generic method influenceCoefficient), the base shear method with Geq = 0.85 GE and Fi ∝ Gi Hi, the modal method, the minimum shear coefficient λ, the seismic combination 1.3(G + 0.5Q) + 1.4E, the elastic drift limits by structure type (1/550 frame, 1/800 frame-wall, 1/1000 wall, 1/250 steel) and the two-level design: the elasto-plastic storey drift under the rare earthquake by the simplified method Δup = ηp Δue (limits 1/50 frame, 1/100 frame-wall, 1/120 wall), and the seismic grades 一-四 by structure type, intensity and height (Table 6.1.2, raised one degree for 乙 buildings) with their factors ηc, ηv, μN and λv reported. Concrete: GB 50010-2010 design strengths (fc = fck/1.4 of C20-C80, fy = fyk/γs), the rectangular block α1 fc over β1 xc with εcu, the axial capacity 0.9 (fc A + fy' As'), beam shear 0.7 ft b h0 + fyv Asv h0/s within 0.25 βc fc b h0, HRB400/HRB500 bars Φ6-Φ40, the column steel limits. Steel: GB 50017-2017 members: f = fy/γR, the width-thickness classes S1-S5, φ of the section classes a-d by the Perry constants of Appendix D, γx 1.05, shear, tension 0.7 fu An. Alpha 9 C20b: GB 50010 torsion on Wt with βt (6.4), punching 0.7 βh ft η um h0 (6.5.1), crack widths wmax with ψ (7.1.2), deflection by B = Bs/θ (7.2), cover by environment class 一-三b (8.2.1), la = ζa lab with laE = ζaE la and the laps ζl (8.3, 8.4, 11.1.7), the member steel limits (8.5, 9.1-9.3), slender columns by Cm ηns (6.2.4), wall shear by the shear span ratio (6.3.21, 11.7.4) and the design yields by bar grade (Table 4.2.3-1); the seismic grade in the member design: ηc, ηvc, ηvb, ηvw on the earthquake part of the forces, γRE (GB 50011 5.4.2), the axial compression ratio μN, the hoops' λv and the grade's detailing (6.3); the vertical earthquake of long spans and cantilevers (5.3.3) and the top force δn (Table 5.2.1); GB 50017 connections (bolts 11.4, fillet welds 11.2) and the seismic steel rules by grade (GB 50011 8.2.5, 8.3, 8.4); GB 50007 fa = fak + ηb γ (b - 3) + ηd γm (d - 0.5) of a qa given without a soil report and the settlement by the layer-wise summation with ψs (5.2.4, 5.3.5). Not covered and taken from BNBC 2020 (named so in the report): the joints of the seismic grade, the corner columns' and the bottom sections' extra factors (6.2.3, 6.2.6), GB 50017's φb (the parent method's χLT is used), GB 50007's fa from the shear strength (5.2.5; the soil report's own qa is kept), masonry, timber, the bar schedule and every table not in covers. Every value names its clause; VERIFY.md lists them, with the uncertain ones, for checking against the printed standards.
